The smartphone UI screen displays a list of radio satellites with their respective details. The main contents and functions of this UI screen include:

1. **Title and Date**: The top bar shows the title "Radio satellites" and the date "2017-04-13".
2. **Satellite List**: A list of satellites with their names and details.
   - **Satellite Name**: Each entry starts with the name of the satellite (e.g., RS-15, OBJECT BX).
